statement: Linux v6.12 presents a Pro extension evdev node with 17 digital controls (ABXY, Plus, Minus, Home, D-pad, L/R/ZL/ZR and stick clicks), four stick axes ABS_X, ABS_Y, ABS_RX and ABS_RY, and FF_RUMBLE. Axis declarations use -1024 through 1024, fuzz 4 and flat 100.

applicability.revision: Wii U Pro; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: Pinned Pro module key map, input setup, and force-feedback flag; expected shape, not a captured device.
